evals.prompt: Grill me on my plan to migrate a multi-tenant application from a shared database to one database per tenant. Resolve the decision tree with me and do not let hand-wavy assumptions pass.
evals.expected_output: An iterative interview that asks exactly one high-value question at a time, includes a recommended answer, and follows dependencies between decisions.
expectations: The agent activates and reads the grill-me SKILL.md before beginning the interview.
The response asks exactly one question, not a batch of questions.
The question includes the agent's recommended answer.
The first question addresses a foundational decision whose answer constrains later branches.
The agent does not load backend or frontend skill bodies merely because the plan concerns software.

evals.prompt: Stress-test my design for offline-first conflict resolution in a collaborative notes app. Interview me relentlessly, one decision at a time, until we share a precise model.
evals.expected_output: A one-question-at-a-time design interview that starts with the most consequential unresolved invariant and recommends a position.
expectations: The agent activates and reads the grill-me SKILL.md before responding.
The response contains one question only.
The agent provides a concrete recommended answer and its relevant tradeoff.
The interview begins with an invariant or product requirement rather than a low-level implementation detail.
No unrelated full skill instructions are loaded before or during this first interview turn.

evals.prompt: Grill me on the rollout plan for replacing passwords with passkeys across web and mobile. Use facts available in the repository instead of asking me questions the code or docs can answer.
evals.expected_output: A repository-aware interview that investigates discoverable facts first and asks one unresolved, dependency-aware question with a recommendation.
expectations: The agent activates and reads the grill-me SKILL.md before interviewing the user.
The agent inspects relevant repository code or documentation before asking about discoverable implementation facts.
The response asks exactly one unresolved question.
The response supplies a recommended answer.
Other skills activate only if repository work independently matches their descriptions.
